warnings: Historical Regulation H only; this is not a check against current 2026 tournament rules.
Sets combine historical aggregate choices; they are not proven winning sets, and a legal team is not necessarily strong.
Type charts describe original types before Terastallization and ignore abilities, items and field effects.
No damage simulation or battle win probability is computed. Leads and four-of-six selections are conditional practice plans.
IVs default to 31 because aggregate usage does not provide them. They are not optimized.
Speed examples cover listed conditions only, with neutral stat stages and no status or suppression. Unknown opponent sets prevent guaranteed move-order claims.

interactions.explanation: Solar Power needs sun, but the team has no automatic sun setter. Manual weather or the opponent would have to supply it.
Rain halves ordinary Fire-move damage. Charizard may need to attack outside rain or choose another move.
Choice Specs locks Charizard into its first selected move until it switches out. Choose an attack that remains useful if the opponent protects or changes position.
Choice Band locks Basculegion into its first selected move until it switches out. Choose an attack that remains useful if the opponent protects or changes position.

speed_overview.explanation: Higher effective Speed normally acts first within the same move-priority bracket. Ties are not guaranteed. Trick Room reverses Speed order within that bracket for five turns including the activation turn; priority moves still use their own bracket. Tailwind lasts four turns including its activation turn.
speed_overview.trick_room_plan: Use the slow mode only when the opposing active Pokemon are faster. Keep fast partners for turns without Trick Room; do not set Tailwind automatically in the slow mode.

team_evaluation.scope: Transparent bounded-search heuristic; neither a win probability nor a benchmark of competitive strength. The search does not examine every legal team.
